firewalls.rule: The RV-LM011 synthesis route may not be marked satisfiable while any of its named prerequisites is unsatisfied. RV-LM011-MAIN must exist, must name its precondition routes, and must depend on every one of them. A prerequisite counts as satisfied only when its transcribed technical status is a passing one AND, where the route requires an organizationally distinct verdict, that verdict is recorded SATISFIED with non-zero independence credit. A technical pass at ZERO organizational independence credit — RV-LM009-MAIN, same provider on both sides — does NOT discharge an independence-requiring gate.

firewalls.rule: A computational receipt, a green test run, a bound reproduction or a carrier binding may never raise the grade or change the status of any claim or premise. A claim whose evidence cites only artifacts of kind receipt, test, carrier_binding or reproduction may not carry a grade stronger than CONDITIONAL; a premise whose evidence cites only those kinds may not carry a discharging status (CLOSED, DISCHARGED, PROMOTED, SATISFIED, CERTIFIED) in either status column.
